name: Mongrelfolk
printedArtCredit: Eric Polak, p. 98 unnamed Mongrelfolk rogue
sourceDistinctions: The table of contents points to p. 97. The entry starts on p. 98, and the traits span pp. 99–100.
Emulate Race automatically meets humanoid race restrictions on magic items. Only nonhumanoid emulation through Use Magic Device gets the +4 racial bonus.
Sound Imitation has a fixed DC 16 Will save. Diffuse Blood applies to eligible race-keyed spells and saves.
The older 2003 Fiend Folio monster and the 2014 fifth-edition Curse of Strahd monster are separate profiles.
portraitForm: Mara Fir Vale, an original Mongrelfolk Rogue
